changelog: Scoring Rules: Added a targeted numeric+unit exception that prevents the generic numeral boost when a marker splits a number from a unit/scale token (e.g., million, billion, percent); such markers are biased downward into a lower target band (0–40). This addresses the en_us_66 over-trust case.

Scoring Rules: Added a targeted downgrade for markers that split adjectival clusters from the noun 'language' (common adjectives such as local/national/official/etc. on the left and 'language' on the right); bias these markers into a lower target band (0–40) to avoid over-scoring isolated adjectives.

Scoring Rules: Added a targeted downgrade for name/organization boosts when the right-side begins a subordinating continuation (right_first in {due, because, to}); if left_last looks like a name/org (capitalized token or common org suffix) and right_first is subordinating, bias the marker downward into 0–40.

Examples: Replaced one example (Officials in the capital...) with a focused number+unit split example illustrating the numeric+unit exception; kept the remaining examples but updated counts to keep all outputs consistent and unique.
